tablerow.td: AP1-AP5
The number of Action Points the action costs.
Free
The action has no Action Point Cost.
Immediate
The character performs a free action immediately, out of turn order.
Interrupt
A type of Out-of-Turn Action that happens early in a combat round.
Multi Round

The action requires many action points and may take multiple characters, multiple combat rounds to complete. The cost is context dependent and determined by the GM but unlike other actions the cost does not need to be paid in one turn. For some of these actions multiple characters can contribute completing the task.
GM Fiat
The GM makes the call as to how long the action takes.
Reaction
An Out of Turn Action takes place outside of the players turn and is triggered by another action. This action takes place after the triggering action.
Free Reaction
A free reaction is an Out-of-Turn Action that does not count towards the characters Out-of-Turn limit.
OOTA or 2 AP
This action can be made as an Out-of-Turn Action or as an action with an Action Point cost of 2.
Noncombat
This action takes far too long to perform in the chaos of combat.
